title: G7 formal preflight accepted incomplete public-label, family-CF, and retry-scope contracts
evidence: Before repair, three read-only mutations returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[]: adding a valid label for a case absent from public cases; changing every complete-plan retry_scope to an unrelated nonempty value; and removing one CF4 public case together with its label and plan rows so one theory family no longer covered CF1-CF4. The former preflight only checked the remaining case/group grid and nonempty metadata.
remediation: Add an explicit formal-input contract for the production runner and formal preflight: require exact public/label case-set equality, exact full-plan retry_scope=all_original_rows_protocol_corrected, CF1-CF4 coverage for every theory family, and one paired_set_id per family with one family per paired set; add adversarial tests and recheck immutable inputs.
